title: Ensure 'Maximum password age' is set to '365 or fewer days, but not 0'
objective: Remediate CIS checkpoint 1.1.2: Ensure 'Maximum password age' is set to '365 or fewer days, but not 0'

parameters.name: max_password_age_days
parameters.description: Maximum password age in days (must be 365 or fewer, but not 0)

steps.name: Apply the Maximum password age policy setting to 365 or fewer days, but not 0, via Group Policy at Computer…
steps.function: 1. Apply the Maximum password age policy setting to 365 or fewer days, but not 0, via Group Policy at Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account Policies\Password Policy\Maximum password age. Expected result: Maximum password age is configured to a value between 1 and 365 days.

steps.name: Verify the Maximum password age setting is configured to 365 or fewer days, but not 0, by reviewing the effective…
steps.function: 2. Verify the Maximum password age setting is configured to 365 or fewer days, but not 0, by reviewing the effective password policy via Group Policy or running `net accounts` on a domain-joined machine. Expected result: Maximum password age shows a value of 365 or fewer days and is not 0 or Unlimited.

compliance_constraints: Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.

This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole, then remediate via the correct path: DC → Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy or GPO cmdlets; Member Server → secedit /export → edit cfg → secedit /configure /areas SECURITYPOLICY. Do NOT use Set-ItemProperty for security policy — it has no effect. Both branches must end with a VERIFY step.
On any failure, report cis_result as ERROR.
reference_procedure:
To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to 365 or fewer days, but not 0:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account
Policies\Password Policy\Maximum password age
